product_summary: Website adeptimpex.com (About us + Products pages, 33 SKUs) shows the company as a manufacturer/exporter of dried organic & conventional herbs, dried medicinal herbs, dried aromatic plants and dried flowers, procured from contract farmers: Rama/Krishna/Vana/Lemon Tulsi (basil), peppermint, spearmint, mint, lemongrass, nettle, lemon balm, rosemary, marjoram, parsley, senna leaves, dandelion root & leaves, burdock root, chicory root (dried & roasted) and chicory cubes, sea buckthorn leaves, rooibos, plus dried flowers — chamomile, jasmine, lavender, rose petals, hibiscus, blue cornflower, butterfly pea flower, safflower petals. Stated certifications: ISO 22000:2005, GMP, NPOP-NOP organic (SGS India). Stated markets: Russia, Romania, EU, Japan, Sri Lanka. No tea (Camellia) products and no dried-fruit/nut-mixture products appear anywhere on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims own processing unit + contract farming (manufacturer), but also 'Manufacturing, Exporting and Supplying' with a distribution network and no visible factory address beyond an office in Kamla Nagar, Agra; trader element plausible. No customs line reviewed here, so the manufacturer claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS comparison: 1211.90 — CONFIRMED as the core line (dried herbs/medicinal & aromatic plants, the bulk of the 33 SKUs). 0813.50 (mixtures of nuts or dried fruits) — WRONG/not corroborated: no dried-fruit or nut product on the site; likely a mis-declaration or a legacy line. 0902.30/0902.40 (black tea, packaged/bulk) — NOT CORROBORATED: no Camellia tea in the catalogue; the site's 'Tulsi' and 'Rooibos' are herbal infusions, which fall under 1211.90 / 1212.99, not 0902. If tea is genuinely traded it must be evidenced by a customs line; otherwise the code should be dropped. Missing from the declaration: dried flowers (chamomile, jasmine, lavender, rose, hibiscus, cornflower, butterfly pea, safflower) — these are a major product line and need their own HS-6 (1211.90 for medicinal/aromatic flowers, or 0603.90 if fresh/cut flowers); chicory root dried/roasted and chicory cubes (1212.99 / 1212.94) are also absent from the declared codes. Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is only partly right — the real profile is botanical raw materials / herbal ingredients for food, pharma, cosmetics and oil extraction, i.e. an agricultural-ingredient supplier rather than an FMCG brand. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, verdict accepted_hs_corrected — correct the code set to 1211.90 + 1212.99 (+ flower line) and remove 0813.50 and 0902.30/0902.40 unless a customs record supports them. All product claims here are from the company's own website only and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено'; no customs/B-L line was examined in this task.
